units.source_text: [\[9\]](#part1333.html#w9) 扬名介是只有官名而没有职务、没有俸禄的一种官职名称。

en.t: [9] Yomyo no suke is the name of a kind of official post that has only a title, with no duties and no stipend.

units.source_text: 这人是夕颜（即第三十六页头中将提到的常夏）的乳母的女婿。

en.t: This man was the son-in-law of Yugao's nurse; Yugao is the Tokonatsu mentioned by To no Chujo at the beginning of page thirty-six.
